text: Entry 1171 centralizes external URL loading after removal of the old security.external_protocol_requires_permission support. Later 1265 introduces mail.external_protocol_requires_permission. Accepted openLinkExternally never requests its own permission prompt for http(s), always requests it for file, and uses the Thunderbird pref for other schemes. The default pref is false. These are helper decisions before the external service runs; native handler availability and prompt execution were not tested. This is source and test inspection only. Full Bugzilla and historical review discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran.
title: Keep the Thunderbird external-permission preference separate from the removed platform preference
